component.name: SuperShot
component.summary: Screenshot tool with configurable delay for GNOME

description.p: SuperShot is a native GTK4/Libadwaita screenshot tool for GNOME desktops. It provides a minimal, focused interface for taking screenshots with a configurable delay timer, delegating capture to the GNOME Screenshot portal.

ul.li: Configurable delay: none, 3, 5, or 10 seconds with visual countdown
Customizable watermark: 5 date formats, custom text, 4 corner positions, white/black color
Preview window with drag-to-crop and live watermark overlay
Clickable desktop notifications (opens image in default viewer)

screenshot.caption: Main application window with capture settings

description.p: Image editor: full editing pipeline (rotate, flip, brightness, contrast, blur, sharpen, grayscale, invert) via the image crate. Apply Crop button with click-to-crop inside selection and undo crop support. Portal-first screenshot capture (works on both Wayland and X11). Temp file cleanup on discard to prevent stale screenshots.

Tabbed interface (Shot/Settings). Customizable watermark with 5 date formats, custom text prefix, 4 corner positions, and white/black color selection. Preview window with live watermark overlay and drag-to-crop. PNG/JPEG format selection, custom save directory, Ctrl+Enter keyboard shortcut. Clickable notifications, duplicate file prevention, and branded filenames.
First public release with English UI, i18n support (14 languages), GSettings persistence, desktop notifications, visual countdown, and CLI headless mode.
